title: 为了逃兵役真拼了！乌克兰掀“跨龄结婚潮”：男子离婚后光速迎娶前岳母
orig_title: 离婚后娶前岳母？乌克兰频现跨龄婚姻，警方严查逃避征召
body:
- 离婚后娶前岳母？乌克兰频现跨龄婚姻，警方严查逃避征召
  - 张璁煜zhangjingjuan@guancha.cn
在乌克兰捷尔诺波尔州，一些适龄应征男子与年长自己数十岁的女性结婚，有人甚至娶了自己的前岳母。这些情况引起了当地警方的注意。 据乌克兰媒体报道，乌克兰捷尔诺波尔州警察局局长谢尔盖·祖巴年科表示，警方已分析该州的婚姻登记数据，发现部分个案有待核查。警方将核实相关婚姻登记是否合法、是否有人借结婚逃避征召，并将重点关注适龄应征男子与残疾女性结婚的情况。 乌克兰警方强调，与残疾女性缔结虚假婚姻，已经成为一种牟利服务，目的是获取陪同残疾人士出境的资格，进而越境出国，或申请延期征召。 祖巴年科称，2024年2月，一名1978年出生的捷尔诺波尔男子与一名66岁的女子结婚。女方来自切尔尼希夫州涅任市，曾是他的岳母。 同年5月，皮德沃洛奇斯克社区一名男子与1979年出生的妻子离婚，随后与前妻的母亲结婚。后者出生于1958年。 据警方统计，2022年，捷尔诺波尔州共登记103桩女方比适龄应征男方年长20岁的婚姻。2023年，这一数字增至276桩。2024年和2025年分别为145桩和138桩。2026年初至今，已有188桩。 祖巴年科提到，这些登记结婚的人中，有不少企业家和当地知名人士。 本文系观察者网独家稿件，未经授权，不得转载。 标签

title: 霍启山娜然官宣恋情！豪门二代迎娶异国娇妻，12月12日香港世纪婚礼倒计时
orig_title: “霍启山娜然宣布恋情”冲上热搜，霍启山在社交平台晒出与演员娜然及霍家人大合照
body:
11月28日，“霍启山娜然宣布恋情”上热搜。据新消息报，霍启山社交平台晒出和演员娜然及霍家人大合照，表示衷心感谢家人、朋友和同事们给予的坚定支持和信任。
此前报道：
2026年6月17日，霍启山与演员娜然被曝婚期临近相关词条登上热搜第一。
去年11月，网曝霍启山、娜然恋爱一年多，还一起参加婚礼。今年，2月网友在意大利美术馆偶遇两人。今年6月，网传他们将在11月于海南三亚举行婚礼。
        
        
            
7月1日，霍震霆接受香港商报采访被问儿子霍启山和娜然的恋情，记者：“最近你们家有喜事，就是启山那边，你对他的女朋友满不满意？”霍震霆笑称：“这件喜事等他自己答，最好直接跟他交流。”
11月11日，“霍启山娜然 结婚”冲上热搜。
据半岛晨报，11日，港媒曝光娜然和霍启山婚礼请柬，两人将于12月12日在香港举办婚礼，喜帖由霍启山父母霍震霆朱玲玲署名。
娜然，1997年4月1日出生于俄罗斯，蒙古族，华语影视女演员、模特。霍启山，1983年生于香港，是霍英东集团副董事长霍震霆与朱玲玲的次子，其兄为霍启刚。
来源 新消息报、半岛晨报、新浪娱乐等

title: 现实版武大郎！绿帽男子隐忍十年患抑郁，终究没忍住提斧追砍第三者
orig_title: 出轨十年后患抑郁持斧，为何只判七个月缓刑？|江西省进贤县人民法院|刘来荣|故意伤害罪|抑郁症_新浪新闻
body:
#男子因女友出轨患抑郁症追砍第三者# 
顺手翻了下这案子的裁判文书。
果不其然还是有点意思的。
根据裁判文书，西门这边是睡了金莲10来年，虽然在第10年奸情败露，也依旧不以为意。
直到第11年，武大因为这档子事情抑郁，后续提斧相向，终于让西门彻底老实。
西门这边的初步伤情鉴定是轻伤一级，按理说还可以继续重新鉴定。
但在挨了一斧子以后，西门果断放弃重新鉴定。
最后，叠加积极赔偿并取得谅解、自首和认罪认罚，武大被判了7个月，缓刑1年。
#有点看法#        
发布于 山东

title: 疯狂派对变枪击地狱！佛州少女民宿庆生遭76次前科黑帮乱枪扫射，致1死6伤
orig_title: 'Girls Gone Wild' Party: 1 Dead and 6 Injured After Shooting
body:
'Girls Gone Wild' Party: 1 Dead and 6 Injured After Shooting
'Girls Gone Wild' 7 Shot, 1 Dead, 1 Critical
A teenage girl's pajama party advertised as a "Girls Gone Wild" event turned into a shooting gallery that ended with one dead and six others injured, according to police in Florida.
Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd held a press conference after the Thanksgiving Day shooting, detailing what the police know so far.
Judd said the violence erupted as a result of the online "Girls Gone Wild" ad that brought about 50 youths from Orlando to the soiree at an Airbnb in Davenport, FL.
Judd said the Airbnb was rented to an adult on behalf of a 16-year-old girl, who was in charge of the party.
After everyone showed up at the bash, Judd said Oral Walker -- an 18-year-old gang member -- whipped out a gun and opened fire. Grady said in a news conference Walker has 76 previous charges.
Another attendee allegedly pulled out his gun and returned fire, killing Walker, and then fled.
Judd said the shooter may have acted in self-defense and encouraged him to come in and talk to investigators.
During the shooting, six other people between the ages of 15 and 21 were wounded by gunfire, Judd said.
The sheriff noted that the 15-year-old girl was in critical condition, while the other surviving victims suffered non-life-threatening injuries.

title: 顶流网红JoJo Siwa刚下达“生娃最后通牒”几天，就惨遭男友光速甩掉！
orig_title: JoJo Siwa and Chris Hughes split just days after she issued brutal baby ultimatum
body:
JoJo Siwa and Chris Hughes split just days after she issued brutal baby ultimatum
See more of our coverage in your search results.
JoJo Siwa and Chris Hughes have broken up after over a year of dating.
The “Dance Moms” alum, 23, ended the romance just days after she declared Hughes, 33, had to get onboard with her baby plans.
“JoJo is really hurt. She loved him and gave everything she had to make the relationship work,” Siwa’s friend told People on Friday.
“For months, behind closed doors, she kept hoping things would change,” the pal continued. “But eventually, she realized that she deserved to feel just as loved and supported as she wanted him to feel.”
The friend said Siwa’s decision to “walk away” from the relationship “wasn’t easy” for her.
“It doesn’t mean [Siwa] stopped caring about [Hughes],” the friend went on. “She just knew she needed to choose herself. She genuinely wishes him well.”
Page Six has reached out to Siwa and Hughes’ reps for comment.
Siwa and Hughes started dating after meeting on “Celebrity Big Brother UK” in April 2025. At the time, Siwa was in a relationship with Kath Ebbs, but they split immediately after filming ended.
Over the next few months, Siwa and Hughes flaunted their romance all over, with the “Love Island” alum declaring in July that he would “love” to marry Siwa.
“I’d be lying if I didn’t tell you I run through scenarios of our wedding day … We’d have a proper English wedding and I can imagine her in a full wedding dress,” Hughes told the Sun’s Fabulous Magazine, noting that the stars “both want kids.”
But during their joint guest appearance on the “Viall Files” podcast Wednesday, the former couple voiced their conflicting timelines about when to start a family.
“I’ve been vocal about this forever. I want a family,” Siwa declared. “We’ve had the conversation … what I really, really want in life. I do want to be a young mom.”
Siwa said she didn’t want to wait “more than four more years” to take the next step in their relationship.
Hughes, meanwhile, admitted that while he wants to be married and have kids “one day,” he doesn’t like to “put a timeline” on those major moments.
“The marriage thing is more there right now, the kid thing is like… I just don’t think I’m ready to be a dad right now,” he said. “Whereas [Siwa] would be a mom tomorrow.”

title: 意难平！《飞越比弗利》女主时隔多年公开吐槽：凭啥男演员先当上制作人？
orig_title: Jennie Garth reveals lingering resentment over Brian Austin Green’s ‘Beverly Hills, 90210’ deal
body:
Jennie Garth reveals lingering resentment over Brian Austin Green’s ‘Beverly Hills, 90210’ deal
See more of our coverage in your search results.
Jennie Garth is still irked that Brian Austin Green scored a producer credit on “Beverly Hills, 90210” before she did.
During a recent episode of her “90210MG” podcast, the actress, 54, welcomed her longtime manager, Randy James, to break down the Season 9 episode “You Say Goodbye, I Say Hello.”
However, before diving into the episode, Garth brought up a decades-old grievance that resurfaced while watching the opening credits.
“I have a question, Randy. Maybe you know the answer to this. I’m really hoping you do,” she said. “Why, when I watched the opening credits of the show — this is the second time I’ve seen it now — Brian Green is listed as a producer?”
James admitted he had a feeling Garth would bring up the subject.
“You thought you got off with me just letting it go?” she jokingly asked.
James replied that he thought he was “done” having to “answer for things that happened 25 years ago.”
The manager explained that he didn’t remember the circumstances surrounding Green’s producer credit, noting that the show’s producer, Aaron Spelling, “did not consult” him “about other actors’ deals.”
The “What I Like About You” alum recalled that, by the following season, everyone received a “producer credit or something” as an incentive to stay on the show.
Still, more than two decades later, Green’s deal continues to bother her.
Want more celebrity and pop culture news?
Start your day with Page Six Daily.
Thanks for signing up!
“But it just always throws me now when I see it. And it’s crazy,” she admitted. “But anyways, whatever. C’est la vie.”
Garth and Green, 53, starred on all 10 seasons of the hit teen drama alongside Tori Spelling and Ian Ziering.
The original cast also included Jason Priestley, Shannen Doherty, Luke Perry and Gabrielle Carteris.
Last September, Green poked fun at Garth’s QVC line via his Instagram Stories, reposting several months-old videos of a social media user mocking the actress’ appearances on the shopping channel.

orig_title: Tim Robinson Calls Burbank Police Officers 'Dirty Pigs' in Online Rant
body:
Tim Robinson Calls Burbank Police Officers 'Dirty Pigs' in Online Rant
Tim Robinson 'Dirty Pigs' in Burbank Got Police Dog Killed!!!
Tim Robinson is telling the Burbank Police Department that he thinks they should leave ... blasting them after a police dog was killed in action.
Here's the deal ... K-9 Spike -- a four-year-old Belgian Malinois -- was shot and killed while chasing a suspect in November 2025.
Waiting for your permission to load the Instagram Media.
The department shared a remembrance post on the first anniversary of Spike's death ... and something about the post set Robinson off -- because he began firing off vitriolic comments in response.
Robinson wrote in the comments, "Dirty pigs made a dog do their violence! Now they celebrate their abuse of an innocent animal? Scum bag pigs."
He then followed it up with another comment ... in which he wrote, "F*** you dirty pigs. Trying to drum up emotion for a dog y’all forced to work. Classic dumb pig s***!"
The comments later disappeared from the post ... and Robinson accused BPD of deleting the comments -- though they denied doing so in a statement to Fox News Digital.
Worth noting ... Robinson isn't the only person who feels using police dogs to chase suspects is controversial. ACLU Action California admonished cops for the practice in a 2024 report -- and many other people blasted the department in the comments section of the remembrance post.
The 'SNL' alum also engaged in a tête-à-tête with the department in connection with alleged police brutality Aerin Robinson claimed he was subjected to.
He accused the department to subjecting community members to brutality in that post ... and the department told him to research why they used pepper spray to subdue suspects.
We've reached out to Robinson and the Burbank Police Department for more information about this feud ... so far, no word back.

title: “结婚22年2儿子非亲生”案续集：前妻被指不仅出轨，还曾拿丈夫堂哥的钱买房
orig_title: “结婚22年2儿子非亲生”案女方被指出轨丈夫堂哥
body:
“结婚22年2儿子非亲生”案女方被指出轨丈夫堂哥
山东淄博“结婚22年两个儿子均非亲生”案有新进展。
2026年11月25日，关联案件中一起涉及姜先生堂哥的赠与合同纠纷，于淄博市桓台县人民法院开庭。
中国新闻周刊此前报道，姜先生和前妻李女士于2023年离婚，在经过一系列怀疑和诉讼后，经法院认定，姜先生与两个孩子无亲子关系。
在这期间，姜先生的堂嫂王某提起诉讼，主张李女士与自己的丈夫存在不正当男女关系，后者曾在两人婚姻存续期间，使用共同财产赠与李女士房产。
根据此前法院调查，2015年，姜先生的堂哥出资为李女士购买了一套房产，后李女士将该房产以92万元售出，其中20万元返还姜先生堂哥，32万元支付了姜先生与李女士共有的一套商品房的首付款。
中国新闻周刊获悉，这已是姜先生的堂嫂王某第三次就相关纠纷提起诉讼。
2025年5月，王某在首次诉讼中主张，本案中的商品房实则是姜先生堂哥使用婚内夫妻共同财产为李女士购置。该案以王某、姜先生堂哥和李女士等人在法院调解方式结案，房产判归王某所有。
姜先生知情后提起诉讼，法院撤销了前述调解书。姜先生表示，所谓堂哥全资为李女士购置房产，并不成立。他介绍，婚姻存续期间，他曾将部分收入存入前妻账户，涉案商品房的部分购房款，是属于前妻名下的夫妻共同财产。
2025年7月，王某以赠与合同纠纷为由，第二次提起诉讼。
该案判决书记载，李女士认可姜先生堂哥2015年曾出资购房并登记在她名下。她在答辩意见中写道：“至于怎么买的，多少钱买的，我都不知道，全部是姜先生堂哥出钱操办的。”
李女士称，上述房产售出后，部分售房款用于她与姜先生的家庭共同生活。2018年之后，姜先生堂哥还多次向她转账，用于偿还案涉商品房贷款。还贷结余的钱款，也被她用于和姜先生的夫妻共同生活开支。
张店区人民法院一审审理认为，王某主张李女士与姜先生堂哥存在不正当男女关系，李女士对此未予否认；姜先生堂哥未到庭，放弃抗辩权利。据此，法院认定姜先生堂哥在婚姻关系存续期间与李女士存在不正当男女关系。
一审法院判令姜先生和李女士共同返还售房款36万元，二审裁定维持一审判决。2026年5月，姜先生一方向山东省高级人民法院申请再审，再审申请已获立案。
同年10月，王某再次向桓台县人民法院递交诉状，主张案涉商品房首付、贷款本息及配套车位均由姜先生堂哥以夫妻共同财产支付，据此要求姜先生、李女士返还费用，合计88万余元。
庭审结束后，姜先生一方告诉中国新闻周刊，该案未当庭宣判。庭审中，他再次主张，涉案商品房是自己和前妻共同出资购买，仅有部分首付款来源于其堂哥。
李女士则曾在答辩中提出，除了王某主张的金额，她实际从姜先生堂哥处取得的款项更多，她同意退还。她同时表示，案涉商品房姜先生未曾出资。
此前，她在接受中国新闻周刊采访时，曾否认出轨相关指控。本次庭审结束后，被问及该问题，她未正面回应：“我怎么说还有意义吗？”
李女士表示，当初是为了大儿子上学，向对方借用房屋。她认可姜先生、她本人与姜先生堂哥之间存在债务关系。中国新闻周刊亦尝试联系王某，但电话无人接听。
中国新闻周刊获悉，因姜先生与李女士离婚后财产纠纷、损害责任纠纷案尚在二审阶段，案涉商品房仍处于查封状态。

title: 感恩节前夕大乱！好莱坞超市惊现持刀歹徒，吓得顾客狂奔逃命，警方当场电击制伏
orig_title: Knife-Wielding Man Sparks Thanksgiving Eve Chaos at Hollywood Grocery Store
body:
Knife-Wielding Man Sparks Thanksgiving Eve Chaos at Hollywood Grocery Store
Hollywood Grocery Store Chaos Cops Swarm, Tase Knife-Wielding Man
Last-minute Thanksgiving grocery shopping turned into absolute chaos in Los Angeles ... with terrified customers running out of a supermarket after a man entered the store armed with a knife.
Dramatic video shows shoppers fleeing the Ralphs grocery store on Sunset Boulevard in Hollywood Wednesday night ... as cops swarm the building and parking lot, securing the area.
Waiting for your permission to load the Instagram Media.
Law enforcement sources tell TMZ ... officers responded to a call of a man with a knife inside the supermarket and ended up tasing the suspect.
We're told cops took the man into custody without further incident, and the Los Angeles Fire Department also responded to the scene because the suspect had been tased. The man was booked for brandishing a weapon.
Despite rumors floating around about a possible shooting, our law enforcement sources are clear ... there was no gunman and no shots were fired.
